title: Causal Intersectionality and Dual Form of Gradient Descent for Multimodal Analysis: a Case Study on Hateful Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model bias towards specific input modalities (text vs. image) by calculating a multimodal intersectional Average Treatment Effect (miATE) and a Modality Interaction Disentangled Attribution Score (MIDAS) using hateful memes and their unimodal benign confounders.
